Safety.title: Your safety is the most important thing
Safety.message: We hear that you are in a lot of pain. Please do not go through this alone. Reach out to your doctor immediately or call emergency services. Your life matters.
Safety.doctorNotified: Your doctor has already been notified that you need support.

Chat.photoRequiredToast: Please take a photo before speaking.
Chat.subtitle: Your mental health assistant
Chat.tapToSpeak: Tap the mic to speak · Or type your message
Chat.welcomeMsg: How have you been sleeping lately? I also noticed your heart rate variability was a bit lower last night.
Chat.photoDesc: To ensure clinical safety, you must take a current photo of yourself before starting the assessment. This helps your doctor verify your current affect.
Chat.photoVerified: Photo verified. You can now start the chat.

Tours.headerDesc: This is your header with language switcher and account menu.
Tours.chatDesc: Tap the microphone to speak, or type text to talk with the AI assistant.
Tours.formDesc: Complete validated clinical questionnaires like the PHQ-9.
Tours.historyDesc: Here you can view all your past assessments and form results.
Tours.wearableDesc: Sync data from your wearable devices so your doctor can see your physiological markers.
Tours.doctorDashDesc: Here you see critical patients and recent alerts.
Tours.doctorPatientsDesc: Use the filters to quickly find patients with flags or critical scores.
Tours.doctorProfileDesc: Review clinical scores, chat history, and prescribe treatment.
Tours.chatPageHeaderDesc: This is a private conversation with the AI. Your doctor sees the summary, not raw messages.
Tours.formsPageHeaderDesc: Validated clinical forms like the PHQ-9 help your doctor understand how you're doing.
Tours.historyPageHeaderDesc: Review all your past check-ins, scores, and progress here.
Tours.wearablePageHeaderDesc: Link a wearable so we can monitor your heart rate, skin temperature, and stress signals.
Tours.patientMessagesHeaderDesc: Send direct messages to your doctor. This channel is encrypted and private.
Tours.doctorDashboardHeaderDesc: Your day at a glance: patient counts, alerts, and recent clinical notes.
Tours.doctorPatientsHeaderDesc: Search, filter, and open any patient by risk, flag, or code.
Tours.doctorProfileHeaderDesc: Clinical scores, physiological trends, and prescribing decisions all live here.
Tours.doctorAddPatientHeaderDesc: Generate a one-time access code your patient can use to link their account.
Tours.doctorAppointmentsHeaderDesc: Patients due for a follow-up based on their latest assessments appear here.
Tours.doctorMessagesHeaderDesc: Pick a patient on the left, then reply in the conversation on the right.
Tours.adminInfrastructureHeaderDesc: Switch between cloud and local AI deployment, and watch system health.
Tours.adminUsersHeaderDesc: Provision doctors, suspend access, and audit accounts here.
Tours.adminLogsHeaderDesc: Every clinical and system action is recorded here — immutable.

Patient.subtitle: Your mental health matters. We're here for you.
Patient.chatDesc: Talk to our AI assistant using your voice or text.
Patient.historySubtitle: Review your past check-ins and questionnaire results.
Patient.noHistory: You have no assessment history yet.
Patient.criticalAlertDesc: Your recent data triggered a clinical flag. Your doctor has been notified and will review your profile shortly.
Patient.criticalAlertBipolarNote: Please note that mood stabilizer screening is required before certain medications can be prescribed.
Patient.conflictDesc: We noticed a discrepancy between your current check-in and past medical records. Your doctor will clarify this at your next appointment.
Patient.wearableAlertDesc: Elevated Skin Conductance Level (SCL) detected in the early morning. This correlates with your self-reported insomnia and triggers a safety flag for your clinician to review.

Doctor.disclaimer: Note: The AI does not prescribe autonomously.
Doctor.guidelinesSource: Clinical Guidelines: Ministry of Health of the Russian Federation

Forms.title: PHQ-9 Depression Scale
Forms.subtitle: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:
Forms.q2: Little interest or pleasure in doing things?
Forms.q3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
Forms.q4: Feeling tired or having little energy?
Forms.q8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed?

AdminInfrastructure.title: AI Infrastructure
AdminInfrastructure.subtitle: Manage your clinical AI deployment and monitor performance.
AdminInfrastructure.uploadDesc: Upload your hospital's approved model (.safetensors, .bin) or Vision-Language Adapter (LoRA) to run completely offline on your local GPU server.
AdminInfrastructure.uploadToast: Model upload simulated. GPU provisioning started.
AdminInfrastructure.perplexityDesc: Lower is better. Measures language fluency.
AdminInfrastructure.chairDesc: Percentage of invented objects in vision descriptions. Lower is better.

PatientProfile.conflictDescMiddle: in their recent chat, but their medical records show a history of:
PatientProfile.missingInfoTitle: Missing Information ({count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} need review)
PatientProfile.aiReasoningAlert: AI Reasoning: The patient scored {score} on the PHQ-9 and triggered a mandatory safety alert. Clinical guidelines require a psychiatric evaluation before initiating pharmacotherapy.
PatientProfile.diagnosisPlaceholder: e.g., F32.1 Major Depressive Disorder, moderate
PatientProfile.treatmentPlanPlaceholder: Enter details on therapy, medication, and follow-up...
PatientProfile.planSavedToast: Clinical plan saved to medical record.
PatientProfile.planIncompleteToast: Please fill out both diagnosis and plan.
PatientProfile.aiNonDiagnostic: Non-diagnostic AI cue. Interpret with clinical judgment.
PatientProfile.howDidAiDetermine: How did the AI determine this?
PatientProfile.howDidAiDesc: The AI analyzed facial landmarks using computer vision to detect micro-expressions, muscle tension, and eye openness.
PatientProfile.noPhotos: No photos submitted by this patient yet.
PatientProfile.missingWarning: Warning: {count, plural, one {# missing clinical data point} other {# missing clinical data points}}. Please resolve before prescribing.
PatientProfile.prescribeBlockedDesc: The AI detected symptoms of mania during the assessment. Do not prescribe Aviandr until a bipolar spectrum assessment is completed by a specialist.
PatientProfile.whyBlockedDesc: The AI detected keywords indicative of mania/hypomania in the patient's chat transcript. Antidepressant monotherapy can trigger severe manic episodes in bipolar patients.
PatientProfile.mandatoryReferral: MANDATORY: Psychiatric Referral Required Before Prescribing
PatientProfile.whyLockedDesc: Patient triggered a MANDATORY safety alert. According to clinical guidelines, psychiatric evaluation is required to determine the safest treatment pathway before prescribing antidepressants.
PatientProfile.noAlertsPrescribingAllowed: No mandatory alerts. Prescribing is allowed.
